reason: The registered compressed-product-display is only the level-one estimate on S_{P,Q} x S_{Q,R}. This node silently applies it with a universal constant to every amplified rectangular pair, but it neither proves nor has an allowed dependency establishing that the amplified dot/compression is Co_{I_n tensor P,I_n tensor R} (equivalently, 1_{M_n} tensor Co_{P,R}=Co_{I_n tensor P,I_n tensor R}) and that the compressed-product estimate therefore holds uniformly in n and for rectangular corners. A level-one bounded bilinear estimate cannot generally be amplified entrywise with an n-independent norm bound. The separately registered amplification/rectangular-product contracts are not among the shard permitted deps, so the claimed K_m step has a genuine missing dependency; the subsequent q_P bound rests on it.
